Rose strolled out of the Halls of Flux, having made certain requests and preparations. She left Diospyra in the care of Saule and the other Saen back in Kureta, it would have been best that she did not witness the preparations that she had been making.

Now that all the trivial matters had been tended to, it was time to deal with the serious concerns. After all, an old friend was in Sentenza, someone she hadn't spoken to lately. That certain someone seems to have gotten distracted, perhaps he has forgotten why he came here. One way or another one thing was clear.

It was time to have a talk.

*****

It was good to be back in Kureta, and to see the Flora begin to flourish once again. The crystal trees littered the streets, making the city shine with a great brilliance, but with none of the harshness of the Sentenzan skyline. Where the crystal seed would usually grow into a tower, and only by force, here it has begun to sprout into a great tree. A fitting image to match the Floran civilization. Sweet, happy memories began to surface, and some terrible ones as well. Rose let them become realized. then regained her focus. There, in one of the more extravagant quarters of the city, was a sweet little lizard she had to talk to.

*****

Rose came to Mar'dy's place of residence, and knocked gently on the door.

*"Hello friend, do you have time for a word?"*
Sabbath restriction is only on new posts.

Mar'dy opened the door a little surprised. "Certainly." he replied.

He brought her up to the watch tower on his home, overlooking the Flora training in his courtyard and the gardens around his home. The noon sun made the pale yellow stone shine in its smoothness. Here in total privacy, he asked, "What word should we have?"

Do you remember why we are here?

Rose whispered, quietly over the skyline.

You've done great work here for the flora, for that I am eternally grateful, but wasn't it about time we left again? Don't you have others that require your assistance, and your guidance?

What have you been doing Mar'dy, why are we still here?

"I've been building this city, making sure things flow smoothly, training the Flora who wish to train." Mar'dy looked down. "But I've wanted to leave, many times. Slip out in the middle of the night and just go and forget everything. I'm sure it can manage itself without me."

He looked up and then pointed to a group of wooden shacks near the lake. "Those are the Deva. There is most coming every day. I'm afraid for them, I really am. The council has asked me to send another letter to resettle them, I haven't sent it. I don't know if it is paranoia, or an illness I'm not sure. This fear. It came with them and I think it has infected me. I am not one to be afraid, but now that I have all this, I am afraid of losing it."

"Stupid stupid fear" He said and hit his head against the pillars of the watch tower. After a long silence,

"We have to go to Arsenal, don't we?"

We don't have to friend, there is a lot of world to see.

Rose paused, sensing the Lot'dy's troubled mind.

Fear is not infectious, in and of itself. There is a lot of world to see, perhaps it would be better to stay away from the source of the madness to ease your addled mind.

If you deem it necessary to quell your worries, then to Arsenal we shall go. If you wish to go elsewhere, we will follow. Perhaps the Saen would like to return to their home, but I will remain with you.

After all, who else is going to stop you from getting into trouble?

"You are right. What do we gain from going to Arsenal? They will just accuse me of being a fleshchanged too or something." Mar'dy said with a smile.

"Let us do something bolder. Something fearless but not stupid."

He produced a map, "the Thorac have been living in the Forest of Brotherhood, unorganized, preyed upon by necromancers, I've heard it all. There is a threat to this world, and good people must fight under a banner. We will head to the Forest of Brotherhood. We will unite them as a nation."

If you so wish.

Rose sighed and let out a slight feeling of amusement.

So, what's this about buckets I've been hearing about?
"Well let me tell you about buckets, theres a lot to know..." Mar'dy said, pulling a rather thick and hefty journal out behind his cape, titled simply: Buckets.
Simple things amuse simple minds. I feel bad for Mar'dy I really do.
